Bare domain 308-redirects to www subdomain

XML sitemap lists all 11 pages with lastmod, changefreq, priority

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers. Only HSTS is present.
findings.recommendation: Add headers() function to next.config.ts with all standard security headers.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: GET /llms.txt returns 404. AI crawlers have no structured guidance.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/llms.txt with site summary and key page URLs.

findings.title: Static Asset Caching Suboptimal
findings.description: Next.js static chunks cached for only 4 hours (max-age=14400) instead of immutable with long max-age.
findings.recommendation: Set longer cache-control for /_next/static/* in next.config.ts.

findings.title: No Preconnect/DNS-prefetch
findings.description: No preconnect for cdn.sanity.io or googletagmanager.com.
findings.recommendation: Add link rel=preconnect tags to layout.tsx.

findings.title: No .well-known/security.txt
findings.description: GET /.well-known/security.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Create /public/.well-known/security.txt with contact info.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage copy is clear and well-structured (481 words)
Case study pages are detailed with project context
Meta descriptions are unique per page and descriptive
Author E-E-A-T signals present via Person schema

findings.title: Blog Posts Are Thin Content
findings.description: Word counts: 310, 273, 271. Well below 600+ word minimum. Posts are listicles with 3-4 sections and no code examples.
findings.recommendation: Expand each post to 800-1200+ words with code examples, real-world case study references, and practical how-to sections.

findings.title: Contact Page Very Thin
findings.description: 94 words, 0 H2 tags, no FAQ, no structured content.
findings.recommendation: Add H2 section, service description, response time, FAQ section. Target 300+ words.

findings.title: Blog Listing Has No H2
findings.description: Blog listing page has 0 H2 tags and 3 H3 tags. Flat heading hierarchy.
findings.recommendation: Add an H2 like 'Frontend Articles & Tutorials' before the article cards.

findings.title: No FAQ Section or FAQPage Schema
findings.description: No FAQ content on any page, no FAQPage JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQ section to About or Contact page with FAQPage schema.

findings.title: Blog Content Not Fresh
findings.description: Blog dates are Nov 2024. No recent posts.
findings.recommendation: Publish new content regularly or update existing posts with new insights.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single H1 on most pages
Meta descriptions present and unique on all 11 pages
Canonical tags correctly set on all pages
robots: index, follow on all indexable pages
Viewport and charset tags correct
Clean heading hierarchy on homepage

findings.title: Title Tag Duplication on ALL Pages
findings.description: Every page title contains the site name twice. Per-page titles include '| Md Rokyuddin' and the layout template '%s | Md Rokyuddin' adds it again.
findings.recommendation: Remove '| ${SITE_NAME}' from per-page title strings. The template already handles it.

findings.title: Duplicate H1 Tags on All Blog Posts
findings.description: All 3 blog posts have 2 identical h1 tags. BlogHeader renders h1 and BlogContent converts # markdown to h1.
findings.recommendation: Change BlogContent # rendering from h1 to h2, or strip first # heading if it matches the title.

findings.title: OG Images Not Unique
findings.description: Blog posts and most pages use generic /twitter-image as OG image. Only homepage and case studies with cover images have unique images.
findings.recommendation: Generate unique OG images per blog post or use cover images.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Person schema on all pages with knowsAbout and sameAs
WebSite schema on all pages
BreadcrumbList schema on all subpages with correct hierarchy
BlogPosting schema with dates, author, publisher, keywords
CollectionPage schema with ItemList on listing pages
Article schema on case study pages
Correct @context, @type, @id usage throughout

findings.title: Person Schema Missing Fields
findings.description: Missing image, worksFor, alumniOf, award fields.
findings.recommendation: Add image (profile photo URL from Sanity) and worksFor fields.

findings.title: BlogPosting Missing image Field
findings.description: BlogPosting schema lacks image field. Google recommends image for Article rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add image field to BlogPosting JSON-LD.

findings.title: No FAQPage Schema
findings.description: No FAQPage schema on any page.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage JSON-LD to About or Contact page.

findings.title: WebSite Schema Missing SearchAction
findings.description: WebSite schema lacks potentialAction for Sitelinks Search Box.
findings.recommendation: Add potentialAction with SearchAction if site gets search.

findings.title: 15 External Scripts + 42 Inline Scripts
findings.description: Homepage loads 15 external JS files and 42 inline script blocks (41.5KB). Only 1 preload directive.
findings.recommendation: Audit Next.js chunk strategy. Consider dynamic imports for below-the-fold components.

findings.title: Homepage HTML is 104KB
findings.description: Raw HTML response is 104,289 bytes due to Next.js RSC payload and hydration data.
findings.recommendation: Typical for Next.js App Router. Monitor LCP in the field.
